description: BOF customer billing support connects invoice readiness, PODs, rate confirmations, detention, accessorials, claims, and customer packet follow-up.
html:
Business Operations / Customer Billing

Turn completed work into a billing-ready packet.

Customer billing depends on proof. BOF ties invoice readiness to PODs, rate confirmations, lumper receipts, detention notes, accessorial approvals, claim status, and customer reference data.

Business OperationsAccounts Receivable

Billing manager lens

An invoice should not outrun its packet.

The office needs to know what is ready, what is missing, what is disputed, and who owns the next touch.

Billing packet

Invoices should be backed by the record a customer can review.

The billing page shows what makes a load invoice-ready and what still blocks customer follow-up.

Invoice support

Rate confirmation, POD, accessorial approval, detention notes, lumper receipt, and customer reference data stay grouped.

Billing holds

Missing POD, open claim, unresolved accessorial, or customer approval gaps stay visible before invoice release.

Customer packet status

Show whether the packet is complete, under review, blocked, or ready for receivable follow-up.

Settlement connection

Billing readiness and settlement readiness can share the same proof record, reducing duplicate follow-up.

Billing packet control

Review the packet before receivables inherit the problem.

Confirm proof, rate, accessorial, detention, claim, and customer-reference support before invoice follow-up.

Open Billing Packet Control
